title: The inquiry
summary: The club that gave your agent the thick envelope is under investigation for paying players to talk them up. A man from the serious paper has a list of names, and yours is on it. The envelope is still in your drawer.

ends.title: Handed in
ends.text: You handed the old envelope to the inquiry, every note still in it. The man from the serious paper called you the only honest name on the list.

ends.title: The drawer
ends.text: The envelope stayed in the drawer. Your name stayed on the list. Nobody ever proved anything.

beats.title: The list

event.title: The list
event.speaker: agent
setup: {broadsheet.name} from the serious paper rings. "That club's under investigation. Payments to players for saying nice things. I've a list of nine names. You're the fourth. Anything to say?"

say: Your agent texts while you're still on the phone: SAY NOTHING.

replies.label: "I've still got it. I'll hand it in."

hand.text: You drive the envelope to the inquiry's office in a carrier bag. A woman counts it twice. Your agent doesn't ring for a month.

nothing.text: He writes "declined to comment". It looks worse in print than it sounded.

agent.text: Your agent tells him it was a loyalty bonus, which is what he told you.

beats.hint: Your name is on a list about the envelope club

beats.title: The report

event.title: The report
event.speaker: agent
setup: A season on. The inquiry's report is out. Sixty pages.

outcomes.text: Page forty-one: one player handed back the full amount. The serious paper puts that line in bold.
Page forty-one: "insufficient evidence". Your name, and eight others.
{broadsheet.short} sends you the page anyway, with the line underlined.
The envelope is still in the drawer.

beats.hint: A season on, the inquiry's report
